Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding the state building code council regulation of processes and equipment used for commercial and industrial processes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the state building code council regulation ofprocesses and equipment used for commercial and industrial processes;and amending RCW 19.27.065 and 19.27A.027.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 19.27.065 and 1996 c 157 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions of this chapter do not apply to: (1) Temporary growing structures used solely for the commercialproduction of horticultural plants including ornamental plants,flowers, vegetables, and fruits. A temporary growing structure is notconsidered a building for purposes of this chapter; (2) Equipment or processes used for commercial or industrialprocessing or activities unrelated to the building structure.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 19.27A.027 and 1996 c 323 s 4 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (((1))) The state building code council shall exempt the followingfrom regulation under this chapter: p. 1 HB 2518 (1) Equipment shelters of personal wireless service facilities frombuilding envelope insulation requirements. (((2) For the purposes of this section,)) "Personal wirelessservice facilities" means facilities for the provision of personalwireless services; (2) Equipment or processes used for commercial or industrialprocessing or activities unrelated to the building structure.
